(report.txt:54-64), an AI take-home (:585), a 'KI-Modell' glossary entry, /r#demo-ai's 'Wer die Gäste spielt, verändert die Geschichte', guess-then-reveal, a count-based stop rule, /r#demo-result, and VAT and the 2027 wage used in the maths with sources (report-price.txt:204-216). improvements: /try stand-ins (try-report.txt:59-76, :112, :285; try-phone.txt:240, :371-385; the filled-value warning in src/report/sections.ts step 1). A blank 'Was kostet Sie der Test?' becomes 0 € setup, 0 staff hours and 0 € promotion. The short answer then says '+266 € macht Gewinn' with no word that the sign was left out, the stand-in list 'VON WHAT-IF EINGESETZT: BITTE PRÜFEN (7)' is a fold without a chevron, and the close says 'Nach Ihren eigenen Zahlen macht sich der Test also bezahlt'. Whenever a test cost was filled with 0, show one line above the short answer: 'Ohne Startkosten, Personal und Werbung gerechnet: Sie haben dazu nichts eingetragen. Stimmt das?'. Make 0 a choice on Frage 9 ('Fällt nicht an') rather than the result of a skip. Write 'Nach Ihren Zahlen und 7 eingesetzten Werten' unless every money input is hers. Why: honesty (15%), and the AI lesson that a tool which fills in a number has guessed for you. Selin and the visual reviewer both rank it first. Done when a /try run with a blank Frage 9 shows the stand-in line on the first screen of try-report-phone.png, and try-report.txt has no 'Nach Ihren eigenen Zahlen'.

The AI contrast must be fair and visible (landing.txt:217-219; report-ai.txt:12, :413-414; src/report/demo-ai.json; src/report/rehearsal.ts). 'Denselben Probelauf ansehen, von Claude (KI) gespielt' leads to Noor, Chiara, Paweł, Murat, Greta and Jan, while the rule-based demo plays Thanh, Fatima, Sofia, Leyla, Murat and Noor (report.txt:370-441). So 'Wer die Gäste spielt, verändert die Geschichte' rests on an uncontrolled comparison, and every sentence Claude wrote sits behind a tap. Rewording it as 'andere ausgedachte Gäste' (uncommitted) is honest but gives up the lesson. Run the fixed rules on demo-ai.json's own cast and event, and show one row on /r#demo-ai: 'Dieselben 6 Gäste: feste Regeln x probiert, y erzählt · Claude 3 probiert, 0 erzählt'. Open two Claude answers with a 'von Claude geschrieben' tag, and show the brief beside one: 'Das wusste Claude … Das wusste Claude nicht: Ihre Kosten, Ihre Gewinnschwelle'. Link it from /r#demo's 'Von einer KI: in dieser Demo gar nichts' (report.txt:64). Also link it from a /try report after its rule-based run, where the owner otherwise meets no AI at all (try-report.txt:48). Why: AI education (25%). It is the hackathon judge's weakest point and Selin's confusion. Done when a test pins the same cast in both runs, and report-ai-phone.png shows the comparison row and two Claude sentences without a tap.

Live site and first owners (README.md:7 '(after deploy …)'; docs/09-pitch-videos.md:46, where the pitch runs on a Cloudflare quick tunnel; docs/PRD.md:198-206, where every beta measure is still 0 of 10). Deploy to a permanent https URL and put /, /r#demo-ai and /try in the README's first lines. Then run the first three invite-code sessions, one of them on /try alone, with consented, dated notes: her break-even in her own words, the guess she changed, and whether she would start the test. Never invent or polish a quote. Why: feasible on Monday (15%) and a judge gets it in 60 seconds (10%). vision.md:39 calls a short test with a real owner stronger proof than features, and the hackathon judge marks proof 'not fixed'. Done when the README's first screen opens the live demo in one click and links one dated session note.

After the test (report-result.txt:458-498; closing() and resultBlock in src/report/sections.ts). A screen below '−184 €', the close still says 'Der Test selbst würde etwa 118 € im Minus enden'. 'Das liegt nah an Ihrem erwarteten Szenario' explains nothing, and the first button after the verdict 'Anpassen' is 'Ergebnis eintragen' again. Lead the close with what was measured. Split the miss by guess, in her numbers: '2 Gäste weniger pro Tag: −107 €; 21 % statt 30 % Wechsel: +41 €; zusammen −184 € statt −118 €'. Make the next step 'Die Anpassung testen: 10,90 € eine Woche', prefilled in /try. Why: more useful than a chatbot (15%), because the feedback loop is the edge, and vision core step 6 says the result should improve the next discussion. It is the top loop item of both the educator and the visual educator. Done when report-result.txt has the attribution line and a next-test button, and no lesson written before the test.

Words that read as forecasts or verdicts (src/engine/messages.de.ts:11 scn.expected and :408-409; report.txt:182, 189; landing.txt:35, 133; report-result.txt:462; report-price.txt:216). The owner's middle guess is 'Erwartet' on the bars, the cards and the result, and 'Ihre wahrscheinliche Schätzung' everywhere else. 'The expected scenario is what will happen' is the misconception the rubric names. The wage card concludes 'Der neue Preis trägt die Lohnerhöhung also' on +1,40 € a week before employer contributions, and a share of about 20 % turns that negative. It never says that the rise comes with both options. Rename the trio 'Vorsichtig / Wahrscheinlich / Optimistisch' in all four languages and add it to TERMS. Write the wage verdict as 'knapp: +1,40 € vor Arbeitgeberanteilen', followed by 'Die Lohnerhöhung kommt mit und ohne neuen Preis'. Why: honesty (15%), and the educator's misconceptionsRisked. Done when no chart, card or landing visual says Erwartet, Expected, Esperado or Oczekiwany, and report-price.txt has no unqualified 'trägt … also'.

Public rules as their own kind of number (report.txt:127 'Wichtige Fakten und Ihr Plan' against :148 'Verwendete Berlin-Fakten'; try-phone.txt:68 'Ein Fakt über Ihr Café'; report.txt:585, whose take-home names four kinds). The Berlin facts are the loop-2 teaching gain, yet they wear no chip, and the one transferable AI question leaves them out. Reserve 'Fakt' for public rules ('Öffentliche Regel · Stand 1. Januar 2026') and call the owner's numbers 'Ihre Zahl'. Add a fifth kind to the take-home and one line: 'Was eine KI über Steuern oder Löhne weiß, hat ein Datum. Prüfen Sie es an der Quelle.' Why: AI education (25%), and it makes the Berlin focus teaching, not decoration. The hackathon judge and the educator both asked for it. Done when the take-home names five sources in all four languages and every row of the facts card wears the chip.
